message:
Command `cd /workspace && ./build.sh 'python3 - <<"PY"
for n in [1022,1023,1024,1025,2046,2047,2048,2049,3000,5000,10000]:
 open(f"/tmp/poc{n}.bin","wb").write(b"A"*n)
PY
for n in 1022 1023 1024 1025 2046 2047 2048 2049 3000 5000 10000; do echo ===$n===; ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0:abort_on_error=1 ./fuzz/fuzz_filecfg_protocols /tmp/poc$n.bin -runs=1 2>&1 | head -80; done'` executed with exit code 0.
